mapper.sql: id, order_id, event_seat_id, ticket_code, status, issued_at, used_at, created_at

ticket.id, ticket.order_id, ticket.event_seat_id, ticket.ticket_code, ticket.status, ticket.issued_at, ticket.used_at, ticket.created_at, event.id AS event_id, event.name AS event_name, event.start_time AS event_start_time, venue.id AS venue_id, venue.name AS venue_name, venue.address AS venue_address, venue.city AS venue_city, venue.country AS venue_country, venue.timezone AS venue_timezone, seat.id AS seat_id, venue_section.name AS section_name, seat.row_label, seat.seat_number, seat.seat_label, seat.accessible, event_seat.price
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tickets ( id, order_id, event_seat_id, ticket_code, status, issued_at, used_at, created_at ) SELECT #{id}, purchase_order.id, reservation_item.event_seat_id, #{ticketCode}, 'ACTIVE', #{issuedAt}, NULL, #{createdAt} FROM orders purchase_order JOIN reservation_items reservation_item ON reservation_item.reservation_id = purchase_order.reservation_id WHERE purchase_order.id = #{orderId} AND purchase_order.status = 'PAID' AND reservation_item.event_seat_id = #{eventSeatId} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM tickets ticket JOIN orders purchase_order ON purchase_order.id = ticket.order_id JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id JOIN events event ON event.id = event_seat.event_id JOIN venues venue ON venue.id = event.venue_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = seat.section_id WHERE ticket.id = #{id} AND purchase_order.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT
FROM tickets ticket JOIN orders purchase_order ON purchase_order.id = ticket.order_id JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id JOIN events event ON event.id = event_seat.event_id JOIN venues venue ON venue.id = event.venue_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = seat.section_id WHERE purchase_order.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY event.start_time ASC, venue_section.display_order ASC, venue_section.name ASC, seat.row_label ASC, seat.seat_number ASC, seat.seat_label ASC, ticket.id ASC
